```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

submissions <- read_csv(
  file.path('data', 'submissions.csv'),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

sessions <- submissions %>%
  mutate(
    track_short = case_when(
      category == "General Industry Studies" ~ "GIS",
      category ==
        "Health Care Systems, Biotechnology, and Pharmaceuticals" ~ "Health",
      category ==
        "Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and AI-Driven Transformation" ~ "Innovation",
      category ==
        "Labor Markets, Organizations, and the Future of Work" ~ "Labor",
      category ==
        "Operations, Supply Chain, and AI-Enhanced Industry 4.0" ~ "Operations",
      category == "Public Policy and Global Competitiveness" ~ "Policy",
      category ==
        "Sustainable Innovation, Energy, and Mobility" ~ "Sustainability",
      TRUE ~ "Panel"
    )
  )
```

# Conference in Brief {.unnumbered}

**CONFERENCE LOCATION**

**George Washington University**

**Milken Institute** and **Science & Engineering Hall (SEH)** — Washington, DC *(Wednesday, June 3)*

**Student Center** — Washington, DC *(Thursday–Friday, June 4–5)*

**METRO STOP LOCATION**

**Foggy Bottom Metro Station** (Blue, Orange & Silver Lines)

**REGISTRATION**

| Day | Location |
|:----|:---------|
| Wednesday, June 3 — morning | Milken Institute |
| Wednesday, June 3 — afternoon | Science & Engineering Hall (SEH) |
| Thursday, June 4 | Student Center |
| Friday, June 5 | Student Center |

```{r}
#| label: conference-brief
#| results: asis
fmt_time <- function(t) {
  t <- str_trim(t)
  period <- if_else(str_detect(t, "PM"), "pm", "am")
  time_part <- str_extract(t, "\\d+:\\d+")
  paste0(time_part, period)
}

brief_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path('data', 'overview.csv'),
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
) %>%
  rename_with(str_trim) %>%
  rename(
    weekday = Weekday,
    time_start = `Time Start`,
    time_end = `Time End`,
    session = Session,
    building = Building,
    room = Room
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(everything(), \(x) str_trim(str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", " "))),
    time_range = paste0(fmt_time(time_start), "—", fmt_time(time_end)),
    location = paste(building, room, sep = ", ")
  )

for (day in c("Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday")) {
  day_data <- brief_raw %>% filter(weekday == day)
  date_str <- switch(
    day,
    "Wednesday" = "Wednesday, June 3",
    "Thursday" = "Thursday, June 4",
    "Friday" = "Friday, June 5"
  )
  cat("**", date_str, "**\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("| Time | Event | Location |\n")
  cat("|:-----|:------|:---------|\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(day_data))) {
    r <- day_data[i, ]
    cat(
      "| ",
      r$time_range,
      " | ",
      r$session,
      " | ",
      r$location,
      " |\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: legend
#| results: asis
legend_data <- sessions %>%
  distinct(category, track_short) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  arrange(category)

cat("**Track Categories**\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(legend_data))) {
  r <- legend_data[i, ]
  cat("- ", r$category, "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n---\n\n")
```
